title: Planetary Feature Fields are Scalable Earth Representations
abstract: arXiv:2609.37784v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Satellite observations, precomputed embeddings, and map products describe the same evolving Earth, yet are stored as independent, petabyte-scale data products. Their continued growth calls for compact representations of multiple products while preserving spatial and temporal detail. We introduce Planetary Feature Fields (PFFs), which exploit redundancy across data products by modeling them jointly as continuous functions of space and time at planetary scale. PFFs are spatially local explicit-implicit (hybrid) neural fields. Each field shares a factored feature volume---a decomposition of an explicit 3D grid with smaller factors---across products, while lightweight implicit decoders reconstruct individual products across multiple timesteps. translated_title: 行星特征场是可扩展的地球表示
translated_abstract: 卫星观测数据、预计算的嵌入向量和地图产品描述的是同一个不断演化的地球，然而它们却以相互独立的、拍字节（PB）规模的数据产品形式存储。这些数据的持续增长要求在保留空间和时间细节的同时，对多种产品进行紧凑表示。我们提出了行星特征场，它通过在行星尺度上将多种数据产品联合建模为空间和时间的连续函数，从而利用数据产品之间的冗余性。PFF 是空间局部化的显式-隐式（混合）神经场。每个场在各产品之间共享一个因子化特征体——即将显式 3D 网格分解为更小的因子——同时由轻量级的隐式解码器跨多个时间步重建各个产品。在相同压缩率下，PFF 对地球观测（EO）产品在空间和时间维度上的重建精度优于单产品神经场。相对于未压缩的源数据，在 1800 倍压缩的情况下，重建……
tldr: 行星特征场（PFF）通过在行星尺度上把卫星观测、预计算嵌入和地图产品等多种数据联合建模为时空连续函数，并利用共享因子化特征体与轻量隐式解码器的混合显式-隐式神经场结构，在 1800 倍压缩下实现了比单产品场更精确的多产品重建，是可扩展的地球表示方法。
en_tdlr: Planetary Feature Fields (PFFs) jointly model satellite observations, precomputed embeddings, and map products as continuous functions of space and time at planetary scale, using spatially local hybrid explicit-implicit neural fields with shared factored feature volumes to achieve more accurate multi-product reconstruction than single-product fields at 1800× compression, making them scalable Earth representations.
